text:
eva: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC refactor + KMS rotation some embeddings-scoped API keys were able to call the chat endpoint. Repro in prod logs, low volume but 100% repro on our test key. :(
chris: ugh. which refactor specifically? per-route scope enforcement or the scope inheritance change?
eva: per-route enforcement change (split scope checks into auth-service -> policy-eval). We also rotated KMS keys around the same time. Logs show scope check falling back to 'legacy' behavior during key metadata lookup.
samir: do you have a minimal repro? need the request/response and any auth debug lines.
eva: pasted curl + response below — reproduced against staging with the same config:
```
POST /v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-emb-only
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"hello"}] }

=> 200 OK (body = chat tokens)
```
log excerpt:
```
[2025-07-18T15:02:11Z] auth-service: scope_check start key_id=kb_XXXX
[2025-07-18T15:02:11Z] kms: lookup metadata failed key_id=kb_XXXX err=NotFound
[2025-07-18T15:02:11Z] auth-service: policy_evaluator: metadata missing -> fallback to legacy_scope_map
[2025-07-18T15:02:11Z] auth-service: scope_check result=allow target=chat route=/v1/chat
```
chris: looks like when KMS metadata isn't present we were falling back to an ACL map that still had per-model wildcards. That fallback should not happen during rotation.
infra-bot: deploy: auth-service v2.4.7 -> v2.4.8 triggered 2025-07-18T14:58:00Z by @deploy-bot
maria: mitigation options: (1) rollback the per-route enforcement change to stop misroutes, (2) immediately mark impacted keys as revoked via KMS (hard revoke), (3) invalidate auth cache so the code path does a strict deny on missing metadata.
eva: i'm leaning to (2) + (3) to avoid a full rollback. impact looks limited to keys in rotation window.
samir: I'll take a hotfix: auth-service will treat missing KMS metadata as DENY unless we have an explicit migration flag. Patch + rollout in canary in next 30m. I'll also add a unit test for the metadata-missing path.
chris: plus add audit fields so we can answer "which key version / kms key" in incidents. Suggest adding these to every auth log entry: `key_version`, `kms_key_id`, `policy_hash`. Also add an alert if scope_check falls back to legacy.
security-bot: new finding created: SEC-2025-142 - "RBAC fallback allowed embeddings keys to access chat during KMS rotation" assigned to samir, priority=P1
maria: who will notify CS/legal if customers were affected? we should prepare a short blurb and list of impacted orgs.
eva: i'll run a query on audit logs for `policy_evaluator: metadata missing` + key ids and export the key list. will post before EOD.
samir: rolling patch out to canary now -> `auth-service:hotfix/no-metadata-deny`
chris: once canary is green, prod rollout with 10% -> 50% -> 100% and invalidate caches. record rollout in incident channel.
eva: quick repro script and exact query i used (for triage):
```bash
# find requests that returned 200 on /v1/chat with embeddings-only keys
jq -r 'select(.route=="/v1/chat" and .auth_scope=="embeddings:read") | .request_id' /var/log/proxy/requests-2025-07-18.jsonl
```
maria: postmortem owners? samir (fix), eva (triage + customer list), chris (audit & alerts), maria (comms).
chris: followups (action items):
- add strict deny on metadata-missing path (samir)
- add audit fields to auth logs (chris)
- CI regression test ensuring embeddings-scoped keys cannot call chat (samir + devex)
- run audit query and notify affected customers (eva + maria)
- document key-rotation safe window and runbook (maria)

eva: acked and starting the audit query now. will update in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
samir: canary passed, rolling to 25%
chris: noted. please ping #incidents once 100% rolled. good catch and quick responses team :lock::thumbsup:
